'''Giant skeletons''' may be encountered while training [[Dungeoneering]], within the [[abandoned floors]] of [[Daemonheim]]. They are the only current undead giants, and as such, they always drop [[big bones]]. All giant skeletons in Daemonheim use a giant battleaxe, although it uses a different animation, to attack. They are occasionally trapped behind obstacles and sceneries and safe-spotted.
